Overview

Goyang is a city in GYE with a population of 1,080,000. A large satellite city northwest of Seoul, known for KINTEX exhibition center and the beautiful Ilsan Lake Park. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
